what: a depth profile of the two AdaLN gains across all 24 DiT blocks, from the per-tensor array already in hand. Tests whether the non-attention half's error is INHERITED through the backward from the attention softmaxes downstream of it, which is what of3t-adaln's finding implies but never checked. No new run.
the_prediction_being_tested: of3t-adaln measured the conditioned transition ALONE against upstream's own module at 5.468736e-03 -- clean -- while the model shows its gain at mass-weighted 0.1828. So the error is not made inside the transition; it arrives in the cotangent. If it arrives from the attention softmaxes, then a block's transition gain should be WORSE the more blocks sit downstream of it in the backward: block 0 has 23, block 23 has none.

conditioned_transition.layer_norm.layer_.reading: depth survives the mass control and mass explains essentially nothing once depth is held. SUGGESTIVE, not conclusive.

attention_pair_bias.layer_norm_a.layer_n.reading: NOT established. The raw correlation does not survive the mass control.

the_confound_that_had_to_be_removed_firs: block index and log mass are 76 % collinear in this model (r = -0.7557) -- later DiT blocks carry far less gradient mass. The raw -0.5789 could have been a mass effect entirely, and reporting it without the partial would have been the same error as reading a worst-tensor list as a location. After controlling: depth -0.4301, mass -0.0150.
why_the_weaker_signal_is_on_the_leaf_wit: the transition gain has NO softmax inside its own block, so whatever it shows is inherited; the attention gain sits directly under its own block's softmax, which adds large block-specific variance (block 8 alone reads 18.504). Inheritance-plus-local-noise predicts exactly this ordering -- the cleaner depth signal on the leaf with no local source -- and that is a weak structural argument in favour, not evidence.

PRE_REGISTERED_TEST.claim_under_test: the transition gain's error is inherited through the backward from attention softmaxes downstream of it.
PRE_REGISTERED_TEST.the_measurement: re-run of3t-adaln's float64-softmax arm across ALL 24 blocks rather than the three it did (8, 0, 12), and recompute the depth profile of the transition gain.
PRE_REGISTERED_TEST.CONFIRMS_if: the depth gradient VANISHES -- partial(log rel, block index | log mass) consistent with zero, and the blocks 0-7 / 16-23 ratio collapsing toward 1.0 from 3.30.
PRE_REGISTERED_TEST.REFUTES_if: a depth gradient of similar size survives an exact softmax, which would mean something other than the softmax accumulates with depth.

honest_limits: n = 24, one partial correlation at t(21) = -2.18, and one outlier (block 7 at rel 0.7439, the only transition gain with cos below 0.95). Depth co-varies with more than the number of softmaxes below it -- activation magnitudes and cotangent norms both change through a residual stack. This is a consistency check that the inheritance reading survives, not a demonstration of it.
provenance: computed 2026-09-20 pass 165 by of3t-orchestrator on pc, CPU only, no device opened, from perf/of3t_orchestrator/pt/device_gradient_043pt.json and the per-tensor reference mass.
